interpretation.primary_rule: Positive: dominant descriptive customer payment proposal or new/revised terms, including identifiable tentative/unfinished proposals. Negative: a known different primary act, including question, report, transfer/help, pause/withdrawal or confirmation of existing terms. Question-shaped offers of new dates are proposals in their supplied context.
interpretation.evidence: Every utterance and supplied semantic context inspected; one exact full-utterance evidence span per row preserves dominant-act context. Pending facts and their prior evidence are context only.
interpretation.date_inventory: Maximal contiguous expressions retain relative operands, open complements, intervals, alternatives, parenthetical interruptions, quoted/hypothetical/negated mentions and corrections. Uncertain procedural temporal expressions have ambiguous presence and unassessed date reference/target mapping.
interpretation.completion_vs_resolution: Complete means expressed grammatical operands are filled, not that a calendar date is resolvable or valid. Demonstratives may complete syntax while lacking antecedents. No current date, week, month, year or unstated working-day calendar was supplied.
interpretation.targets: Date-expression payment targets follow explicit product scope or clear supplied conversational scope; anchor events involving another product do not automatically add a payment target. Two target-ambiguous quotations retain both available plans with scope unobserved. Empty arrays on uncertain procedural surfaces mean mapping unassessed.
interpretation.privacy: Assessed per utterance as synthetic surface disclosure suitability: no direct identifier or credential is present; generic emotional self-description is non-identifying. No bank/privacy-policy groundtruth or deployment eligibility is inferred from phase.
interpretation.offsets: Python Unicode codepoints and UTF-8 byte offsets into the original current utterance, with exact /records/N/input/utterance/text pointers.

limitations: Source-only synthetic LLM engineering judgments with source-only self-adjudication; no human validation, inter-annotator agreement or IID/gold claim.
Inherited fallback workhorse is not verified GPT5.6.
Calendar normalization is unresolved unless the source supplies a full valid calendar token; invalid full tokens are distinguished from unfinished expressions.

No-date arrays and non-enumerated candidate surfaces mean unassessed, never asserted absence. Pure discourse ordering words such as first/again/next-step and implicit temporal meaning are not asserted DATE values.
Conversational pause/sequence surfaces are retained as ambiguous DATE candidates without payment targets, rather than forcing their applicability.
Privacy_surface_eligible is an operational synthetic-surface assessment; the schema provides no further privacy taxonomy.
Ignored helper-path status was assumed from the user-provided path and not verified by reading Git or ignore files.
Machine validation proves structure/source binding, not semantic correctness.
